metadata.name: solana
metadata.description: zKube game program for Solana and MagicBlock

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: magic_fee_vault
docs: protocol infrastructure for gasless ER VRF and is unrelated to the
owner's base-layer player funding PDA.

accounts.name: player_state
docs: this unchecked prevents Anchor from serializing a stale outer copy over
the changes made by the self-CPI.

accounts.name: player_funding
docs: account is accepted; no retired program-owned layout is convertible.

fields.name: daily_score
docs: Arena leaderboard score: engine score plus pressure-scaled challenge bonus.

fields.name: daily_bonus_triggers
docs: Number of actions that earned nonzero Daily challenge bonus credit.

fields.name: perfect_trigger_available
docs: Perfect-clear trigger may award at most once between player moves.

fields.name: replay_hash
docs: Domain-separated rolling commitment over rules, VRF rows, and actions.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for the deferred credit instruction version and bounty schema.

fields.name: bonus_multiplier_x100
docs: Raw objective points are scaled by this value before pressure.

fields.name: map_rules
docs: Rules that define one consistent identity across the whole map.

fields.name: active_run_id
docs: Zero when idle; otherwise the only run that may exist for this owner.
This durable pointer makes resume deterministic across devices and
prevents two valid device sessions from opening concurrent runs.

fields.name: achievement_flags
docs: Bit per canonical achievement; the catalog is bounded to 24 entries.

fields.name: lifetime_xp
docs: All progression XP, regardless of whether it came from achievements,
quests, Daily play, or finite Campaign rewards.

fields.name: unlocked_maps
docs: Bit `map_id - 1`; Map 1 is unlocked on initialization.

fields.name: level_stars
docs: Two bits per Campaign level across all maps.

fields.name: weekly_attendance_mask
docs: One bit per weekday with a free Practice or paid Arena completion.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved for the deferred five-run credit schema. It has no v1 meaning.

fields.name: campaign_map_count
docs: Number of contiguous, authority-activated Campaign maps.

types.name: RewardVault
docs: Program-owned native-SOL reserve used only for pre-funded Weekly prizes.
